title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
description: A prestigious program for international students pursuing master's or PhD studies in the United States.
eligibility: Non-U.S. citizen with strong academic record
benefits: Tuition support, living stipend, health coverage, and travel allowance depending on country program.
howToApply: Check your local Fulbright commission timeline and rules
Prepare transcripts, recommendation letters, and personal statement
Submit the application through the official Fulbright channel in your country

title: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
description: Leadership-focused scholarship for graduate study at Stanford University across all eligible programs.
eligibility: Applies to a full-time Stanford graduate degree
benefits: Full funding for graduate study, leadership development, and cohort-based mentorship opportunities.
howToApply: Apply separately to Stanford program and Knight-Hennessy
Prepare leadership essays and recommendations
Complete and submit online application before deadline

title: AAUW International Fellowships
description: Fellowships for women who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents to pursue graduate or postdoctoral study.
eligibility: Identifies as woman and is not U.S. citizen/permanent resident
Holds a degree equivalent to U.S. bachelor's
Plans full-time study or research in the U.S.
Shows commitment to women and girls through leadership or service
benefits: Funding support for tuition, fees, and educational expenses based on award level.
howToApply: Create account on AAUW application portal
Upload academic, professional, and recommendation documents
Submit completed fellowship application online

title: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
description: Highly competitive scholarship supporting doctoral students with research excellence and leadership.
eligibility: Nominated by a Canadian institution with Vanier quota
benefits: CAD 50,000 per year for three years during doctoral studies.
howToApply: Confirm nomination process with target Canadian university
Prepare research contributions and leadership evidence
Submit application through the institution's Vanier workflow

title: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
description: University of Toronto scholarship for exceptional international secondary-school students.
eligibility: International student in final year of secondary school
Applying to an undergraduate program at University of Toronto
benefits: Covers tuition, books, incidental fees, and residence support for four years.
howToApply: Receive school nomination for Pearson Scholarship
Apply to an eligible undergraduate program at U of T
Submit scholarship application within required timeline

title: UBC International Scholars Program
description: Need-and-merit based awards for international undergraduate students at the University of British Columbia.
eligibility: International student entering first undergraduate degree
benefits: Substantial funding that can cover a major portion of study and living costs based on need.
howToApply: Apply for admission to UBC and submit required forms
Complete financial information and personal profile
Provide supporting documents before scholarship deadline

title: Chevening Scholarships
description: UK government scholarship for future leaders to pursue a one-year master's degree in the UK.
eligibility: Undergraduate degree qualifying for UK postgraduate entry
Meets work experience and return-home requirements
benefits: Tuition, monthly stipend, travel costs, and selected additional allowances.
howToApply: Review Chevening country-specific eligibility
Prepare leadership essays and references
Submit online application through official portal

title: Rhodes Scholarship
description: World-renowned scholarship enabling exceptional students to study at the University of Oxford.
eligibility: Applies through an eligible Rhodes constituency
benefits: Oxford University fees, living stipend, and travel support to and from the UK.
howToApply: Check your Rhodes constituency requirements
Prepare academic documents and personal statement
Submit Rhodes application and complete interview process

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
description: Scholarship for outstanding applicants outside the UK to pursue postgraduate study at Cambridge.
eligibility: Non-UK citizen applying for eligible full-time postgraduate degree
Strong intellectual ability and leadership potential
Commitment to improving lives of others
benefits: Full cost scholarship including tuition, maintenance allowance, and airfare support.
howToApply: Select eligible Cambridge course and apply for admission
Complete Gates Cambridge statement and references
Submit by relevant round deadline

title: Australia Awards Scholarships
description: Long-term development scholarships offered by the Australian Government for students from partner countries.
eligibility: Commitment to development outcomes in home country
benefits: Full tuition, return airfare, establishment allowance, and living support during study period.
howToApply: Check participating countries and approved institutions
Prepare academic and professional documents
Apply via Australia Awards portal before deadline

title: Research Training Program (RTP)
description: Australian government-supported funding for domestic and international postgraduate research students.
eligibility: Applying for research master's or PhD at participating university
benefits: Tuition offset and/or stipend support depending on institutional RTP allocation.
howToApply: Choose Australian university and research supervisor
Submit admission and scholarship documents
Complete RTP scholarship process through the university

title: Destination Australia Scholarship
description: Scholarship encouraging study in regional Australia through participating education providers.
eligibility: Enrolled in eligible program at regional campus/provider
Complies with visa and residency conditions when applicable
benefits: Up to AUD 15,000 per year to support study and living costs in regional Australia.
howToApply: Find participating regional providers and eligible courses
Prepare provider-specific scholarship application
Submit all required documents before internal deadline
